title: text-align - Typography - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
TYPOGRAPHY text-align Utilities for controlling the alignment of text. Class Styles text-left text-align: left; text-center text-align: center; text-right text-align: right; text-justify text-align: justify; text-start text-align: start; text-end text-align: end; EXAMPLES Left aligning text Use the text-left utility to left align the text of an element: So I started to walk into the water. I won't lie to you boys, I was terrified. But I pressed on, and as I made my way past the breakers a strange calm came over me. I don't know if it was divine intervention or the kinship of all living things but I tell you Jerry at that moment, I was a marine biologist.
